name: Mukudori Chidori
source:
A sophomore who enjoys sex freely. Maiko is often angry with her because she has sex whenever she feels like it.

Some of the boys are afraid of her because of her demand for intense sex.

[From [url=http://pacopacosoft.jp/dl/pk004/]official site[/url]]
